title: Prayer and Meditation Consistency
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(duration_min) as minutes by _time
| eval practised=if(minutes>0,1,0)
| streamstats reset_after="(practised=0)" sum(practised) as streak
| sort - _time
description: Tracks your daily prayer or meditation practice and the current run of consecutive days kept.
value: A gentle consistency streak supports a habit that is easy to let slip when life gets busy.
implementation: Ingest practice sessions into `index=personal`; compute the daily streak.
visualization: Single-value panel of the current practice-day streak.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It tracks your daily quiet time and how many days in a row you have kept it, gently encouraging the habit.
